@@name@@The Darkin Blade@@icon@@false@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@icon3@@The Darkin Blade.png@@icon4@@The Darkin Blade 2.png@@description@@'''Aatrox''' can activate ''The Darkin Blade'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 1-second static cooldown between casts. If '''Aatrox''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.@@description2@@'''Active:''' '''Aatrox''' performs a strike with his greatsword for each of the three casts, dealing physical damage to enemies hit within an area. Enemies hit within a Sweetspot of the area take [[File:Successfully enhanced damage physical icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] 75% '''bonus''' damage and are also [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocked up]] for 0.25 seconds. Each subsequent cast gains 25% more damage.@@description3@@'''First Cast:''' '''Aatrox's''' first strike affects a 625 × 180-unit rectangular area in the target direction, with him centered on the back line and the Sweetspot at the farthest edge.@@description4@@'''Second Cast:''' '''Aatrox's''' second strike affects a trapezoidal area in the target direction, with the Sweetspot at the farthest edge. The hitbox begins 100-units behind '''Aatrox''' and extends 475-units in front of him, measuring between 300 and 500-units wide from behind to in front.@@description5@@'''Third Cast:''' '''Aatrox's''' third strike affects a 300-radius circular area centered on a target location that is 200 units in front of him, with a 180-radius Sweetspot within.@@description6@@''The Darkin Blade'' deals 55% / 60% / 65% / 70% (based on level) damage against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]]. Against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]], the first cast deals 25 '''bonus''' physical damage, which is affected by the subsequent cast and Sweetspot damage modifiers; and the [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knock up]] duration from hitting the Sweetspot against them is doubled to 0.5 seconds.@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@
'''First Cast Damage:'''
10 / 25 / 40 / 55 / 70 (+ 60 / 67.5 / 75 / 82.5 / 90% AD)
'''First Sweetspot Damage:'''
17.5 / 43.75 / 70 / 96.25 / 122.5 (+ 105 / 118.125 / 131.25 / 144.375 / 157.5% AD)
@@leveling4@@
'''Second Cast Damage:'''
12.5 / 31.25 / 50 / 68.75 / 87.5 (+ 75 / 84.375 / 93.75 / 103.125 / 112.5% AD)
'''Second Sweetspot Damage:'''
21.875 / 54.6875 / 87.5 / 120.3125 / 153.125 (+ 131.25 / 147.65625 / 164.0625 / 180.46875 / 196.875% AD)
@@leveling5@@
'''Third Cast Damage:'''
15 / 37.5 / 60 / 82.5 / 105 (+ 90 / 101.25 / 112.5 / 123.75 / 135% AD)
'''Third Sweetspot Damage:'''
26.25 / 65.625 / 105 / 144.375 / 183.75 (+ 157.5 / 177.1875 / 196.875 / 216.5625 / 236.25% AD)
@@leveling6@@
'''Maximum Non-Minion Non-Sweetspot Damage:'''
37.5 / 93.75 / 150 / 206.25 / 262.5 (+ 225 / 253.125 / 281.25 / 309.375 / 337.5% AD)
'''Maximum Non-Minion Sweetspot Damage:'''
65.625 / 164.0625 / 262.5 / 360.9375 / 459.375 (+ 393.75 / 442.96875 / 492.1875 / 541.40625 / 590.625% AD)

An enemy is considered to be hit by the ability based on [[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] [[:Range|edge range]] - i.e. if any part of your [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|gameplay radius]] is within the hitbox, you are affected. * The third cast, as well as the Sweetspot for the first and second cast, function like [[ground-targeted]] abilities. An enemy is considered to be hit by the ability based on [[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] [[:Range|center range]] - i.e. an enemy's center has to be within the hitbox to be affected. * As implied by the previous point, the Sweetspot for the first and second cast is implemented as separate [[area of effect|areas of effect]] to the main component of the ability. Deathbringer Stance.png|20xpx|border|link=Aatrox#Deathbringer Stance|An icon for Aatrox's ability Deathbringer Stance]] [[Aatrox#Deathbringer Stance|Deathbringer Stance's]] cooldown reduction. ** The Petrifying Gaze]] [[Cassiopeia#Petrifying Gaze|Petrifying Gaze]], is the direction he is moving, and not the direction the model is facing. * All damage modifiers [[File:Multiple stacking icon.png|20px|link=Stacking#Stacks_multiplicatively|An icon representing the keyword Stacks multiplicatively]] [[:Stacking#Stacks_multiplicatively|stack multiplicatively]]. * There's a small period of time in which Aatrox can't declare basic attacks after casting ''The Darkin Blade''.(unexpected) * This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically. *
